title: Launch Sentinel: Coordinated Risk Protocols, Rapid Rollback Paths & Stakeholder Briefs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create a coordinated, auditable set of launch risk controls and communication artifacts so we can safely release runtime-1.22 with clear abort/rollback gates, per-channel comms, and a single source of truth for stakeholders.

Scope:
- Define pre-flight abort criteria (telemetry and manual) and automated guardrails.
- Author and vet rollback packages (code + config + model pin + db migration reverts) and an execution checklist.
- Produce templated incident communications for internal, cross-functional, customer-facing, and status-page updates.
- Coordinate release notes wording and public FAQ with Legal and Docs.
- Wire the runbook to PagerDuty escalation and Console SLO dashboards for fast situational awareness.

Deliverables:
- Preflight Stoplight Matrix (green/amber/red) with exact metric thresholds and owners.
- Rollback playbook (one-click checklist + manual fallback) and permissions list of who can approve/execute.
- Suite of communications templates (internal hot channel, exec brief, customer-facing email, status-page snippets).
- Release notes draft and set of Q&A bullets for support and CSMs.
- Post-release measurement checklist and rollback verification steps.

Notes on scope boundaries: This ticket focuses on coordination, artifacts, and handoffs. Actual automation (e.g., scripted rollback) will be tracked in ENG sub-issues and only referenced here as dependency entries.
acceptance_criteria: Stoplight matrix exists with measurable thresholds and named owners for each signal
Rollback package repo/PR links and an execution checklist are documented and tested in staging
Communication templates reviewed and approved by Legal and Support; stored in Confluence and Slack snippets
Release notes section written, approved, and staged for deployment; Docs and CSM have Q&A deck
Escalation flow integrated with PagerDuty and linked to Console dashboards for the release
rollback_plan_summary: Primary rollback is model-pin revert + runtime config rollback to runtime-1.21 with validated KV cache flush and traffic switch to fallback pool. Secondary fallback is capacity throttling + feature gate disable for new batching. Execution requires two approvers (PM + Eng lead) unless auto-triggered by critical SLO breaches defined in Stoplight red thresholds.
comm_templates: Internal urgent: 1-paragraph incident summary + immediate mitigations + required action (to engineering/SEs)
Cross-team brief (15m): TL;DR, impacted routes, mitigation path, stakeholder action items
Customer-facing: brief transparent status, expected ETA, affected features, rollback options and customer support contact
Status page snippet: short headline, current state, impact severity, next update ETA
Postmortem notify: timeline of events, root cause hypothesis, immediate mitigating changes, long-term fixes
